title: Proof map document
description: A hierarchical proof graph. Nodes are statements or inference steps, edges carry the statements passed between nodes, contexts hold assumptions shared by a region. A node may open into a subgraph. See SPEC.md.

floor.description: Where refinement stops. reader: what the reader already has. source: the level of detail the source text gives.

parent.description: The node this graph is the subproof of. null for the top graph.

drafts.description: Free-form work in progress attached to a node. Not normative.

text.description: What is fixed, in what order limits are taken, standing assumptions.

nodes.description: Ids of the nodes inside this context.

provides.description: Ids of parent-level inputs that this context supplies to every node inside it.

summary.description: One line shown on the map.

statement.description: What the node gives, in full.

inputs.description: Ids of the nodes this node receives from.

status.description: complete: atomic with a derivation, or its subgraph is complete and the boundary matches. sketch: not yet. Absent: not assessed.

state.description: confirmed is set only by the user.

library.description: Counterpart in an outside library, with differences. '없음' if none.

external_ref.description: For kind=external: the id, in the parent graph, of the node this stands for.

inherit_statement.description: Take statement and conditions from the referenced parent-level node.

subgraph.description: Id of the graph that proves this node.

local_context.description: For an atomic node: the context restated for this vertex.

derivation.description: For an atomic node: the lines of the single calculation. Each line cites incoming edge ids, the context or the floor.

author_filled.description: Present when this line goes below the level of the source text. Says what was filled in.

produces.description: Which derivation lines yield each outgoing edge.

layout.description: Grid position for the viewer. Optional; has no meaning for the proof.

kind.description: flow: a result becomes an input. call: a rule or fact is used. definition: an object fixes notation.

label.description: Display name if different from id.

summary.description: Short content shown on the map.

statement.description: Everything this edge carries. An edge carries a part of the sender's output, not all of it.

not_carried.description: What the sender outputs that this edge does not carry, and where that goes.

substitution.description: Legacy (complete=false). In the complete form a substitution is its own node.

fit.description: Legacy (complete=false). Why the carried statement meets the receiver's conditions.

status.description: open: no node provides this yet.

complete.description: true: statement is the full content. false: statement is only a name or summary.

loop.description: Required when from == to. An induction: the index must decrease.
